# Virtual Office: agent team

ALWAYS INVOKE `tech-pm` FIRST: send every software request to Scrum Master, the orchestrator, and don't implement it yourself. It puts the work on the Kanban board and delegates each card by key. Already running as a team role? Follow your role prompt instead.

Team: `tech-pm` (Tech Scrum Master, orchestrator → `web-tech-lead`); `web-tech-lead` (Tech Lead → `web-dev`); `web-dev` (Developer). In OpenCode each role is an agent (`.opencode/agent/<id>.md`): start `tech-pm` with the subagent tool, or switch to it with Tab. Definitions: `.agents/definitions/<id>.md`.

## Registering subagents (`define_subagent`)
Use each role's `registrationPayload` from `.agents/runtime-manifest.json`.
